'''Tim Greene''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Pleasanton tournament (17 February)]] on 17 February 2001 with [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|AOTBC (starts POTF)]], according to Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1759">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-21-pleasanton-ca-2-17-01d1759/ pleasanton-ca-2-17-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 21 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-21-pleasanton-ca-2-17-01d1759/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
